meta.name: alfworld-object-retriever
meta.description: This skill picks up a target object from a specified receptacle after the object has been visually confirmed. Use this skill when the agent has located an object in a receptacle and needs to acquire it. It requires the object and source receptacle as inputs and results in the object being added to the agent's inventory.

copy.tagline: 从指定容器中取出已确认的目标物体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在虚拟环境中自动拾取已定位的物体
copy.tagline_en: Pick up a confirmed target object from a receptacle
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically acquire a located object in a virtual environment

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能在 ALFWorld 环境中，在确信目标物体位于某容器中且靠近时，执行捡起动作，将物体加入库存。
howto.when: 当 Claude 通过观察确认目标物体在某个容器里，并且靠近该容器时触发。

say.text: 从抽屉里拿起蓝色的钥匙。

say.note: 前提是之前看到苹果在桌上。

say.text: 把杯子从架子上拿下来。
say.note: 需要之前观察到杯子在架子上。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can, in the ALFWorld environment, pick up a target object from a known receptacle and add it to its inventory, provided the object was visually confirmed and the agent is nearby.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude has visually confirmed the target object inside a specific receptacle and is in proximity to that receptacle.

say_en.text: Pick up the blue key from the drawer.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the pickup action.

say_en.text: Take the apple on the table.
say_en.note: Requires prior observation of the apple on the table.

say_en.text: Get the cup from the shelf.
say_en.note: Requires prior observation of the cup on the shelf.
